DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Meikyokan
secret group
assassins
Kage massacred everyone in my hometown...
lines: Kage massacred everyone in my hometown...
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: Kage massacred everyone in my hometown...

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Don't mess with a Ryukyu warrior!
lines: Don't mess with a Ryukyu warrior!
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: Don't mess with a Ryukyu warrior!

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: I hear the weeping of departed souls...
lines: I hear the weeping of departed souls...
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: I hear the weeping of departed souls...

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: I can't just leave them like that...
lines: I can't just leave them like that...
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
I can't just leave them like that...
Someone must stop it...

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Since ancient times, Bushido has had
lines: Since ancient times, Bushido has had
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
Since ancient times, Bushido has had
an absolute code of "loyalty".

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: But if your master deviates from that code,
lines: But if your master deviates from that code,
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
But if your master deviates from that code,
 what should you do?

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Is giving up "loyalty", also one way of Bushido?
lines: Is giving up "loyalty", also one way of Bushido?
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: Is giving up "loyalty", also one way of Bushido?

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Ready!
I can't believe Meikyokan is
lines: really a secret group of assassins!
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
I can't believe Meikyokan is
really a secret group of assassins!

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: And now that I know their secret,
lines: And now that I know their secret,
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
And now that I know their secret,
they'll come after me.

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: What am I going to do!?
lines: What am I going to do!?
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: What am I going to do!?

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: I know what Utsusemi will do.
lines: I know what Utsusemi will do.
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: I know what Utsusemi will do.

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: However, if he fights Utsusemi,
lines: at best they'll kill each other.
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
However, if he fights Utsusemi,
at best they'll kill each other.

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: I can't let that happen.
So it was for this venomous cursed blade, Yugiri...
lines: So it was for this venomous cursed blade, Yugiri...
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: So it was for this venomous cursed blade, Yugiri...

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: If I do nothing,
lines: it's as if I'm waiting for him to kill me.
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text:
If I do nothing,
it's as if I'm waiting for him to kill me.

DATA3/O05.DAT.text: Should I go after him...or not?
lines: Should I go after him...or not?
DATA3/O05.DAT.full_text: Should I go after him...or not?

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: So this is what freaked him out...huh?
lines: So this is what freaked him out...huh?
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: So this is what freaked him out...huh?

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: Still alive? Hey!? Why did you order
lines: Still alive? Hey!? Why did you order
Black Lotus to massacre my people? Why!?
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Still alive? Hey!? Why did you order
Black Lotus to massacre my people? Why!?

lines: Why did this have to happen!?
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Why!? Godammit!
Why did this have to happen!?

That's what Utsusemi said...
I feel drained.

The sky...so blue.
Just like back in Ryukyu...

The only thing missing are
Ryukyu purple butterflies.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: We live in two totally different worlds.
lines: We live in two totally different worlds.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: We live in two totally different worlds.

lines: but it's not the sword's fault.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Yugiri, the cursed sword...
but it's not the sword's fault.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I had no idea there was someone else behind him...
lines: I had no idea there was someone else behind him...
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: I had no idea there was someone else behind him...

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: But unless we do something about it,
lines: But unless we do something about it,
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
But unless we do something about it,
Tatara shrine will be destroyed.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I'll rebuild Kage, and take revenge
lines: I'll rebuild Kage, and take revenge
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I'll rebuild Kage, and take revenge
on our enemies...I swear it!

He was here just now...
I'm sure I saw him!

lines: It's not as if I'm going off to die...
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Don't worry...
It's not as if I'm going off to die...

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I, Black Lotus, have lived the Samurai code
lines: I, Black Lotus, have lived the Samurai code
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I, Black Lotus, have lived the Samurai code
for 10 years.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I never expected things to end this way.
lines: I never expected things to end this way.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I never expected things to end this way.
But, this is my fate.

I lived for Bushido...and now...
I'll die for it!

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: What a waste...killing yourself like that.
lines: What a waste...killing yourself like that.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: What a waste...killing yourself like that.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: Always posing even till the end.
lines: Always posing even till the end.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: Always posing even till the end.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: And I was a fool for waiting for you so long.
lines: And I was a fool for waiting for you so long.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: And I was a fool for waiting for you so long.

lines: I even beat the Dojo Master...
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I won...
I even beat the Dojo Master...

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I'm so much stronger now, it feels like years
lines: I'm so much stronger now, it feels like years
have passed since my first kill.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I'm so much stronger now, it feels like years
have passed since my first kill.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: I think I'm finally beginning to understand
lines: I think I'm finally beginning to understand
what I've been taught so many times.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
I think I'm finally beginning to understand
what I've been taught so many times.

lines: At first, I was only trying to stay alive.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Sorry...
At first, I was only trying to stay alive.

lines: I know how addictive murder is.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
But now, because of you,
I know how addictive murder is.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: `I don't have time for any of
lines: `I don't have time for any of
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
`I don't have time for any of
your childish jokes, boy!"

This isn't a joke...
it's about getting stronger...that's all.

`Certainly even a killing machine
like you...must have had doubts?"

lines: there's no need for someone like me.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Now with Kage gone,
there's no need for someone like me.

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: Now I have nowhere to go...
lines: Now I have nowhere to go...
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: Now I have nowhere to go...

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: No matter how difficult the way may be...
lines: No matter how difficult the way may be...
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: No matter how difficult the way may be...

DATA3/O14.DAT.text: This is the only way I know.
lines: This is the only way I know.
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text: This is the only way I know.

lines: Hanzaki, is this what made you go crazy?
DATA3/O14.DAT.full_text:
Yugiri, the cursed sword...
Hanzaki, is this what made you go crazy?

lines: For the first time in my life,

I've taken a life.

lines: don't throw your life away for nothing.

don't throw your life away for nothing.

lines: You massacred a whole Ryukyu village?
DATA7/V02.DAT.full_text:
Bastard!
You massacred a whole Ryukyu village?

lines: `It's all right. This must be fate."
DATA7/V02.DAT.full_text:
Master Utsusemi!
`It's all right. This must be fate."

Master Utsusemi!
I deeply respected you.

DATA7/V02.DAT.text: I can't believe I beat you.
lines: I can't believe I beat you.
DATA7/V02.DAT.full_text: I can't believe I beat you.

DATA7/V02.DAT.text: All I wanted was to kill the Dojo Master
lines: All I wanted was to kill the Dojo Master
DATA7/V02.DAT.full_text:
All I wanted was to kill the Dojo Master
for Utsusemi...

lines: I didn't mean for you to get involved.
DATA7/V02.DAT.full_text:
I'm sorry.
I didn't mean for you to get involved.

DATA7/V03.DAT.text: I know it's not your fault.
lines: I know it's not your fault.
DATA7/V03.DAT.full_text: I know it's not your fault.

DATA7/V03.DAT.text: I don't care who comes against me.
lines: I don't care who comes against me.

DATA7/V03.DAT.text: There's no way I'm going to die.
lines: There's no way I'm going to die.
DATA7/V03.DAT.full_text: There's no way I'm going to die.

lines: You're years away from beating me.
DATA7/V03.DAT.full_text:
Humph!
You're years away from beating me.

lines: Why did we ever join Meikyokan
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text:
Why did we ever join Meikyokan
in the first place?

DATA7/V04.DAT.text: I didn't want to kill you.
lines: I didn't want to kill you.
It was the Dojo Master's orders, wasn't it?
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text:
I didn't want to kill you.
It was the Dojo Master's orders, wasn't it?

DATA7/V04.DAT.text: I never should have tried to escape.
lines: I never should have tried to escape.
We're all just killing each other...
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text:
I never should have tried to escape.
We're all just killing each other...

lines: What have I got to fear? Ha ha ha...
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text:
I've broken the code...have no `loyalty".
What have I got to fear? Ha ha ha...

DATA7/V04.DAT.text: Should I have turned and run away?
lines: Should I have turned and run away?
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text: Should I have turned and run away?

DATA7/V04.DAT.text: `Make your decision, then stand by it."
lines: `Make your decision, then stand by it."
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text: `Make your decision, then stand by it."

DATA7/V04.DAT.text: Then, I'll never run away again.
lines: Then, I'll never run away again.
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text: Then, I'll never run away again.

lines: `You did well. I'll leave the rest to you..."

Your wounds aren't fatal.
Take care of yourself.

lines: if I keep running away like this.
DATA7/V04.DAT.full_text:
Nothing will be solved
if I keep running away like this.

not in the same league as the others.

Humph!
You're not cut out for this kind of work.

DATA7/V07.DAT.full_text:
If you're here,
then that means he's nearby...

with my own two hands...!

DATA7/V07.DAT.text: I have no time for this!
lines: I have no time for this!

DATA7/V08.DAT.text: Why did you order Black Lotus to massacre
lines: Why did you order Black Lotus to massacre

Why did you order Black Lotus to massacre
my people!?

lines: He must have been controlled by someone else...
